title: A fee entered as a part is priced by the tier unless it has a fixed price
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is % Off 10.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, put on tier A for work orders in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new inventory part for this test used as a fee (for example a shop supplies kit), in category A, cost $10.00, with a fixed sell price of $12.50.
  • Have a second new inventory part for this test used as a fee (for example a fuel surcharge), in category A, cost $10.00, with no fixed sell price.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, made after customer A's tier was set, with one labor line (line 1).
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Add the fixed-price fee part to line 1 from the catalog search.
  3. Add the other fee part to line 1 from the catalog search.
  4. Click the Parts tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens on its Lines tab.

Step 2:

  • The fixed-price fee part comes in at $12.50.

Step 3:

  • The other fee part comes in at $12.15: $10.00 × 1.35 = $13.50, less 10% = $12.15.

Step 4:

  • Priced by reads Fixed price on the first fee part.
  • Priced by names tier A on the second.
